description: This is a Python script implementing a video processing pipeline that uses YOLO for object detection, downloads and uploads videos and frames to S3, and optionally interacts with a MySQL database to store detections. It includes environment variable loading, S3 operations, video frame sampling, detection filtering, and CSV logging.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Data class to hold environment configuration parameters including database and AWS credentials.

methods.name: Config load_env_from_local()
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a local '.env' file and constructs a Config object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] parse_s3_uri(uri: str)
methods.description: Parses an S3 URI into bucket and key components, allowing spaces in the key.

methods.name: make_s3_client(cfg: Config)
methods.description: Creates a boto3 S3 client, using provided credentials or default environment configuration.

methods.name: str download_s3_to_temp(s3_client, bucket: str, key: str)
methods.description: Downloads an S3 object to a temporary local file and returns its path.

methods.name: str upload_file_to_s3(s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str)
methods.description: Uploads a local file to a specified S3 bucket and key, returning the constructed URL.

methods.name: init_db(cfg: Config)
methods.description: Initializes a database connection, creating the database and table if necessary, or returns None if not configured.

methods.name: insert_detection_row(conn, row: dict)
methods.description: Inserts a detection record into the database.

methods.name: ensure_csv_with_headers(csv_path: Path)
methods.description: Ensures the output CSV file exists with the appropriate header row.

methods.name: append_csv_row(csv_path: Path, row: dict)
methods.description: Appends a detection record as a row in the CSV file.

methods.name: str build_output_key(prefix: Optional[str], filename: str)
methods.description: Builds the S3 object key path based on prefix and filename.

methods.name: draw_annotations(frame, boxes, class_names, confidences, color=(0, 255, 0))
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on video frames for detections.

methods.name: int get_frame_interval(cap)
methods.description: Determines the sampling interval in frames to roughly sample every 4 seconds based on FPS.

methods.name: Iterator[Tuple[int,float,any]] iter_sampled_frames(cap)
methods.description: Generates frames sampled at the specified interval along with their index and timestamp.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Tuple[float,float,float,float]],List[str],List[float],List[int]] filter_bear_detections(result)
methods.description: Filters detection results to keep only 'bear' class detections, returning boxes, class names, confidences, and class IDs.

methods.name: run_pipeline( input_path_or_s3: str, model_path: str, output_bucket: str, output_prefix: Optional[str], csv_file: Path, min_conf: float, )
methods.description: Main execution function that coordinates model loading, frame sampling, detection, visualization, S3 upload, CSV logging, and optional DB insertion.

methods.name: Optional[str] getv(key: str, default: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: download_s3_to_temp
ctags.pattern: /^def download_s3_to_temp(s3_client, bucket: str, key: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: filter_bear_detections
ctags.pattern: /^def filter_bear_detections(result) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[float, float, float, float]], List[str], /

ctags.name: getv
ctags.pattern: /^    def getv(key: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:$/

ctags.name: run_pipeline
ctags.signature: ( input_path_or_s3: str, model_path: str, output_bucket: str, output_prefix: Optional[str], csv_file: Path, min_conf: float, )

ctags.name: upload_file_to_s3
ctags.pattern: /^def upload_file_to_s3(s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str)
